tasks.question: How does the theme retrieval method in the LaTeX theme factory resolve precedence when a name exists in both predefined themes and user theme directories?
tasks.reference_answer: ThemeFactory.get selects self.themes[name] if present; otherwise it searches user themes and falls back to Theme(name). It then updates the chosen theme with configuration before returning (sphinx/builders/latex/theming.py:115-123). Built-ins therefore take precedence, but there is no early return bypassing update. The code does not document the asserted stability rationale.

tasks.question: What is the semantic significance of the processing order where the declarator following parentheses is processed before the declarator inside parentheses in the type identifier generation method for parenthesized C++ declarators?
tasks.reference_answer: get_type_id applies next to the returnTypeId before passing the result to inner (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:3237-3241). In int (*func)(int,int), inner is *func and next is the following parameter suffix (int,int). Building the function type first and then its inner pointer structure preserves pointer-to-function grouping; the reference reverses these roles.

tasks.question: What is the propagation mechanism of the return value of the boolean method that determines spacing requirements after type specification sequences through the abstract syntax tree node hierarchy of declarator wrappers that influences whitespace insertion decisions in type declaration formatting?
tasks.reference_answer: Pointers and references delegate the spacing query to next (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:2832-2833,2945-2946), but parenthesized declarators return True directly (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:3209-3210). ASTType uses that boolean plus nonempty declaration specifiers to insert text or node spaces (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:3449-3470). Not every wrapper recursively propagates the child result.

tasks.question: Why does the equality comparison method in the parenthesized expression node class return the special sentinel value instead of the boolean false value when comparing with incompatible types?
tasks.reference_answer: ASTParenExpr.__eq__ returns NotImplemented for incompatible types and compares expressions otherwise (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:663-666). This leaves Python an opportunity to try the other operand's equality implementation instead of asserting inequality immediately. If neither handles equality, default equality behavior applies; == does not fall back to __ne__. Cooperative comparison does not guarantee symmetry for arbitrary classes.
